title: Good Afternoon
label: ch:ka-good-afternoon
canDo: I can wish someone good afternoon in Kannada, and fall back on ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ when I want a greeting that fits any hour.

payoff.summary: Say ಶುಭ ಮಧ್ಯಾಹ್ನ — built on the "noon" word rather than ಅಪರಾಹ್ನ — and reach instead for ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ, the greeting confirmed to work at any time of day.
